Line regulation (3.5 mV/V vs 0.86) and PSRR at 1 kHz (52 vs 60 dB) both point to too little low-frequency loop gain and too much supply feedthrough. I'm changing the program rather than refining, so the main feedthrough path becomes a searchable parameter.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Line reg and 1 kHz PSRR fail: loop gain too low and supply feedthrough high. Driver L5 was hardcoded 0.2 um, so M5 gds injects supply current into the diode/pass gate. Make L5 a parameter, lengthen OTA and pass L for gain, raise Ahf for 1 kHz gain. Idiv fixed at 5 uA to stay at 12 parameters."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gm1":  (15.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":   (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "I1":   (30e-6, 16e-6, 44e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "gml":  (6.0, 4.0, 12.0),       # NMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Ll":   (3.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gm5":  (8.0, 5.0, 16.0),       # driver NMOS gm/Id at max load
    "L5":   (0.6, 0.15, 1.5),       # driver L (sets supply feedthrough via gds5)
    "gmp":  (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),       # pass / diode gm/Id at max load
    "Lp":   (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),
    "K":    (10.0, 5.0, 30.0),      # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "Ahf":  (12.0, 4.0, 30.0),      # OTA high-frequency gain = gm1*(ro1||Rz)
    "Cz":   (40e-12, 10e-12, 200e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]; CL = spec["cl"]
    imax = spec["iload_max"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    beta = vref / vo
    Idiv = 5e-6; K = p["K"]; I1 = p["I1"]
    Ib2 = 5e-6
    L5 = p["L5"]

    def vgs_for(dev, W, L, Id, vds):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ib2, vds=0.6)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib2, vds=0.8)
    mt  = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, I1, vds=0.3)

    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gm1"], p["L1"], I1 / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gml"], p["Ll"], I1 / 2, vds=0.6)
    vts = vref + m1.vgs
    tail_vsd = vdd - vts

    gm1 = m1.gm
    ro1 = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Adc = gm1 * ro1
    Ahf = min(p["Ahf"], 0.5 * Adc)
    Rz = 1.0 / max(gm1 / Ahf - 1.0 / ro1, 1e-9)
    Cz = p["Cz"]

    Ipmax = imax + Idiv
    Ipmin = imin + Idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], Ipmax, vds=0.6)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], Ipmax / K, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gm5"], L5, Ipmax / K, vds=0.6)

    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vo / vref - 1.0)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("Mb2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("Mb3", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb3)
    n.dev("Mt", "ts", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vref", "ts", "ts", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "fb", "ts", "ts", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "zc", Rz)
    n.C("Cz", "zc", "vss", Cz)
    n.dev("M5", "gp", "o1", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "gp", "gp", "vin", "vin", m6)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "gp", "vin", "vin", mp)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    I5min, I5max = Ipmin / K, Ipmax / K
    vgs5min = vgs_for("n", m5.W, L5, I5min, 0.6)
    vgs5max = m5.vgs
    dvgs5 = abs(vgs5max - vgs5min)
    dI = imax - imin
    load_reg = dvgs5 / (beta * Adc) / dI
    under = dvgs5 / (beta * Ahf) + 0.02

    g56 = m5.gm / m6.gm
    ap = mp.gm / mp.gds
    w = 2 * math.pi * 1e3
    zlag = Rz + 1.0 / (1j * w * Cz)
    A1k = abs(gm1 * (ro1 * zlag) / (ro1 + zlag))
    feed = 1.0 + ap * m5.gds / m6.gm
    psrr = db(beta * A1k * g56 * ap / feed)
    line = feed / (beta * Adc * g56 * ap)

    offs = abs(m3.vgs - vgs5min) / Adc / beta
    verr = 100 * offs / vo
    iq = iref + Ib2 + I1 + I5min + Idiv

    ugf_max = beta * Ahf * m5.gm * K / (2 * math.pi * CL)
    cg = mp.cgg + m6.cgg
    fgate_max = m6.gm / (2 * math.pi * cg)

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": verr,
        "iq": iq,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "line_reg": line,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "undershoot": under,
        "overshoot": under,
        "ripple_settled": 0.003,
        "_Adc": Adc, "_Ahf": Ahf, "_Rz": Rz, "_tail_vsd": tail_vsd,
        "_W_pass": mp.W, "_vgs_pass": mp.vgs, "_ugf_max": ugf_max, "_fgate_max": fgate_max,
    }
```
